data.key: Mythic Path Ability ~ Symbol of the Holy
data.name: Symbol of the Holy
data.description: As a standard action, you can create a wooden holy symbol dedicated to your deity. If it ever leaves your possession, it fades away after 1 hour. Whenever you use this holy symbol as a divine focus when casting a spell, you don't need to have any other material component, unless that component costs more than %1 gp.|Ability_SymboloftheHoly_GP
